skillSays: Measure first: run a live Lighthouse or trace on the real page, use the failing audits to locate causes, then re-run the same conditions after the fix
Report evidence with conditions (URL, form factor, throttling, cold cache, median of three runs) and keep lab data separate from field data; missing CrUX data is 'unavailable', never 'passing'
Performance: defer or remove render-blocking scripts, preconnect to third-party origins, trim fonts to the weights used with font-display swap, and code-split

Accessibility to WCAG 2.2: native buttons and links, focus visible, 4.5:1 contrast, a main landmark, a lang attribute, ordered headings, and manual keyboard checks because automation covers only a subset
SEO: unique title, meta description, canonical, viewport, crawlable links and real heading content; do not promise ranking changes or invent structured data
Findings are listed by severity with evidence, fix and a verification status that says what is still unproven

changes: Measured before editing: long tasks and input-event latency under a 4x CPU throttle exposed that the original crashes on the first clock tick and, once repaired, blocks 1.1 s per 4 s with a 544 ms keystroke
Used the guide's own patterns: React.lazy code splitting for the chart, a per-method lodash import, a 150 ms debounce on the search box and content-visibility:auto on the long sections
Final result under the same conditions: no long tasks in 4 s idle, slowest keystroke 56 ms, last data on screen at 224 ms instead of 1618 ms, initial JS 166 KB to 53 KB gzip
Said which fixes did not come from the guide (isolating the clock, memoised rows, the chart-effect cleanup) because the guide has no React re-render advice
Ran Lighthouse 13.5 three times before and after instead of eyeballing the file: performance 81 to 100, accessibility 27 to 100, SEO 80 to 100, best practices 88 to 100; FCP 2.97 s to 0.65 s
Used the failing audits to find the real blockers (jQuery 1.96 s, unused moment, an 18-weight font stylesheet with display=block) and removed them, rather than guessing
Checked the keyboard path by hand with puppeteer (the old Tab key reached nothing; the new link and cookie button work with Tab and Enter) and computed every old and new contrast ratio
Stated what is unverified: field data unavailable on localhost, placeholder canonical domain, no screen reader run, and no invented JSON-LD or sitemap
